value: Relative to controls, bvFTD patients exhibited significant gray matter reduction in the right amygdala, hippocampus and parahippocampal gyrus; bilateral orbitofrontal and ventromedial frontal regions including the gyrus rectus and anterior cingulate cortex; and the left inferior and middle temporal gyri.
This atrophy pattern is consistent with the classically reported frontal, insular, cingulate, and temporal atrophy in bvFTD.

spans.text: One cluster located in the frontal lobes included the bilateral OFC and the right ventromedial prefrontal cortex, and extended to the right insula and the right ACC. Moreover, two clusters of significant GM reduction were found in the left and right temporal lobes, respectively. The first cluster included the left inferior temporal gyrus and extended to the fusiform gyrus. The second cluster comprised voxels in the right amygdala, the hippocampus, and the parahippocampal gyrus.
